title: About
subtitle: What is isrv and how does it work?

whatIs.title: What is isrv?
whatIs.body: isrv is a minimal, self-hostable file sharing service. It is designed to be simple: upload a file, get a link, share it. No accounts required, no tracking, no clutter.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.body: Files are uploaded via a drag-and-drop interface or a file picker. Each upload is assigned a short, random identifier and stored on the server. Files expire automatically after a configurable period and are removed during periodic cleanup runs.

techStack.title: Tech stack
techStack.backend: Backend: Go with the Fiber web framework
techStack.frontend: Frontend: React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS
techStack.storage: Storage: local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage

selfHosting.title: Self-hosting
selfHosting.body: isrv is open source and designed to be self-hosted. You control where your files are stored, how long they are kept, and who can upload. Refer to the project repository for setup instructions.
